messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — vendor Spendvisor sent pricing + integration details. They want to ingest our billing exports for analytics and anomaly detection. Link: https://spendvisor.example/pricing (trial creds in DM)

Ashwin Patel: quick Q — is this seat-based or usage-based? could affect monthly variability.

Maria Gomez: Sales sent a draft: Base $1,800/mo + $0.08 per 1k ingestion events after first 10M events. POC discount 6 weeks free + 20% off first year if we commit.

Julian Park: Security checklist: do they support SSO (SAML/SCIM), encryption in transit+at rest, and customer-managed keys? we need KMS/HSM for Private deployments.

Ella (Legal): Please route the DPA and data processing terms. If they want to store raw billing data, we need retention limits and delete-on-demand. No vendor can keep PII longer than 90 days.

Kevin Chen: Finance: what's the expected monthly ingestion? rough ballpark will decide seat vs usage. Also need the budget code and PO threshold. If this stays under $5k/mo we can approve on our side, otherwise need procurement sign-off.

Samir Rao: From eng side: integration is straightforward if they accept GCS exports or S3. They claim native BigQuery connector which would be nice. Latency: they do near-real-time (5–15m). For our usage, 20M events/month likely.

Ashwin Patel: 20M events => after 10M free, 10M * ($0.08 / 1k) = $800/mo in variable cost + $1,800 base = $2,600/mo pre-discount.

Maria Gomez: Good math. With 20% first-year discount that's $2,080/mo effective.

Procurement Bot: Requested: vendor security questionnaire, SOC2 report, sample DPA. Procurement playbook step: attach vendor quote + estimated TCO + legal ok.

Julian Park: Also confirm retention granularity — do they store line-item P0-level billing or aggregated metrics? If raw line items, needs tighter access controls.

Ella (Legal): Flag: cross-border processing. If they process outside EEA/UK for EU customers, we need SCCs or equivalent.

Kevin Chen: Approving POC up to 2 months and data sandbox ingestion (non-prod billing only) up to $0. No commitments beyond that until legal OKs DPA and SSO tested.

Maria Gomez: Sounds good. Request: procurement, can you start vendor security questionnaire + attach quote? Budget code ENG-ANALYTICS-23.

Procurement Bot: Assigned to procurement team. Ticket: PROC-4721. I'll upload the vendor questionnaire now.

Ashwin Patel: One more ask to vendor: can they provide sample TCO comparison vs our in-house query infra? want to see break-even horizon for 12/24 months.

Samir Rao: If we run in-house, infra cost estimate ~ $1,200/mo plus maintenance; so roughly comparable at scale. Need precise workload numbers to calc.

Maria Gomez: I'll ping sales for a custom TCO calc and push for extended trial (8 weeks) and 30% if we commit to 12 months.

Kevin Chen: If they accept 12mo commit with 30% discount and an exit clause after 90 days for broken promises, I can approve the finance term sheet.

Ella (Legal): I'll review the DPA once procurement uploads it. If the vendor passes SOC2 + SCCs and supports CMK, legal won't block.

Procurement Bot: Uploaded: vendor-quote.pdf, SOC2-redacted.pdf, sample-DPA.docx to PROC-4721.

Maria Gomez: Thanks — moving to POC phase pending legal sign-off. Will update thread with POC creds and scope. :+1:

Ashwin Patel: :eyes: will set up a sandbox ingestion pipeline and share scripts. We'll test with synthetic non-prod exports.

Julian Park: ping me when SSO test account is ready.

Maria Gomez: Last update planned within 72 hours after DPA review.
